title: Tolerance Band Credit on Metering Service Repeat Test Fees
content:
A **Metering Service** test result that is within tolerance but close to the edge of the tolerance band earns a band credit against the repeat test fee charged for it.

**Band position.** The band position of the charged result is the absolute difference between its registration percentage and 100, divided by the meter type's accuracy tolerance.

**Clause.** Where the band position is at least the outer-quarter share of 0.75, the result sat in the outer quarter of the tolerance band and the band credit is the outer-quarter credit of 100.00. Where the band position is at least the outer-half share of 0.5 and below 0.75, the band credit is the outer-half credit of 50.00. In every other case there is no band credit.

## Band credit by meter type, in registration points away from 100

| Meter type | Tolerance | Outer-quarter credit of 100.00 when the result is off 100 by at least | Outer-half credit of 50.00 when off 100 by at least, and by less than the outer-quarter figure |
|---|---|---|---|
| Non-Communicating Opt-Out Meter | 2.0 | 1.50 | 1.00 |
| Standard AMI Smart Meter | 2.0 | 1.50 | 1.00 |
| AMI Bidirectional Net Meter | 2.0 | 1.50 | 1.00 |
| AMI Three-Phase Commercial Meter | 2.0 | 1.50 | 1.00 |
| AMI Interval Demand Meter | 1.0 | 0.75 | 0.50 |
| Primary Metering Installation | 0.5 | 0.375 | 0.25 |

Results on either side of 100 are treated alike: 98.50 and 101.50 both sit 1.50 points away.

## Both sides of each threshold (hypothetical results, tolerance 2.0)

| Charged result | Points from 100 | Band position | Band credit |
|---|---|---|---|
| 101.50 | 1.50 | 0.75 | 100.00 |
| 101.49 | 1.49 | 0.745 | 50.00 |
| 99.00 | 1.00 | 0.5 | 50.00 |
| 99.01 | 0.99 | 0.495 | None |
